patch.summary:
Choose Buffer only if your buying job matches “Social media scheduling, analytics, and engagement with a free plan and per-channel Essent” rather than Freshmarketer's shape. Choose Freshmarketer only if your buying job matches “Freshmarketer is Freshworks’ marketing automation product covering email and multichannel ” rather than Buffer's shape. Workflow advantage: Buffer leans social-media-marketing, content-marketing; Freshmarketer leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Buffer is Social media scheduling, analytics, and engagement with a free plan and per-channel Essentials/Team pricing.; Freshmarketer is Freshmarketer is Freshworks’ marketing automation product covering email and multichannel engagement, segmentation, journeys, landing pages/.
- Company-size focus: Buffer (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Freshmarketer (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Buffer-leaning social-media-marketing, content-marketing, brand-monitoring vs Freshmarketer-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Buffer — Free plan caps channels and scheduled posts; Freshmarketer — Public page collapses paid SKUs into Enterprise + contact add-ons — contact scaling can dominate cost.

Limitations — Buffer: Free plan caps channels and scheduled posts; Not a social listening command center like Brand24; Freshmarketer: Public page collapses paid SKUs into Enterprise + contact add-ons — contact scaling can dominate cost; Legacy inventory URL /freshmarketer/ is broken (404).
